def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    # The solid color-2 boundary and the non-background object determine which
    # outer edge of the object gets a full line of color 8.
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if all(all(v==2 for v in row) for row in grid):
        # horizontal divider: stripe beyond object, away from divider
        divider=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==2 for v in row))
        k=r1+1 if r0>divider else r0-1
        if 0<=k<h: out[k]=[8]*w
    elif all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h) for c in [0]):
        # vertical divider in first column; beam extends along object's side
        # farthest from divider
        k=c1+1 if c0>0 else c0-1
        if 0<=k<w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][k]=8
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Find full-length divider of color 2 and the object in the other color.
    hr = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if hr is not None:
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
        if not cells: return [row[:] for row in grid]
        lo,hi=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
        k=hi+1 if lo>hr else lo-1
        out=[row[:] for row in grid]
        if 0<=k<h: out[k]=[8]*w
        return out
    if all(grid[r][0] == 2 for r in range(h)):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
        if not cells:return [row[:] for row in grid]
        lo=min(c for r,c in cells)
        # Bring object against the divider side, leaving a color-8 stripe on its far side.
        shift=lo-1
        out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h): out[r][0]=2
        for r,c in cells:
            nc=c-shift
            out[r][nc]=grid[r][c]
        stripe=lo-shift+1
        if stripe<w:
            for r in range(h):out[r][stripe]=8
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
PY
